description.en:
The bandwidth for async replication, in Kbps.

> This parameter is not yet available.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value for this parameter from your client. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh: 异步复制关系的描述信息。
description.en: The description of the replication pair.

description.zh:
是否开启复制时间控制（RTC）。取值范围：

- false：关闭。
- true：开启。

默认false。

> 若复制对已加入复制组，则与复制组的属性保持一致。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable replication time control (RTC). Valid values:

- false: Disables RTC.

- true: Enables RTC.

Default value: false.

> If a replication pair is part of a replication group, its RTC setting is the same as the setting of the group.
The name of the replication pair.

description.zh: 一致性组设定的RPO值，单位：秒。当前仅支持900秒。
description.en: The recovery point objective (RPO) of the replication pair-consistent group. Unit: seconds. Currently, only a value of 900 is supported.

description.zh: 异步复制关系中主盘或从盘所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~354276~~)查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息。
description.en: The region ID of the primary or secondary disk in the replication pair. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~354276~~) to query the regions that support async replication.
The ID of the replication pair.

title.zh: 修改云盘异步复制关系

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

- 异步复制功能支持的地域请参见[云盘异步复制概述](~~314563~~)。
- 当异步复制关系处于**已创建**（`created`）或**已停止**（`stopped`）状态时，可以修改名称或者描述信息。
descriptions.en:
## Description

- For information about the regions that support the asynchronous replication feature, see [Overview of asynchronous replication](~~314563~~).

- You can modify the name or description of a replication pair only when the pair is in the **Created** (`created`) or **Stopped** (`stopped`) state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs modify-disk-replica-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --replica-pair-id pair-cn-dsa0000 --pair-name TestReplicaPair --description This_is_description. --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --bandwidth 10240 --rpo 900 --enable-rtc true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ebs ModifyDiskReplicaPair --region cn-hangzhou --RPO 900 --Description 'This_is_description.' --EnableRtc true --PairName TestReplicaPair --Bandwidth 10240 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ReplicaPairId 'pair-cn-dsa0000' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000'
